en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a town built on the lower slopes of a wooded hill. The foreground and midground are filled with large villas and houses with steep roofs and ornate facades, typical of late 19th–early 20th century Central European spa architecture. At the top edge, red printed text identifies the location as Bad Harzburg and specifies that the image shows villas on the Papenberg hill.
